remarks: Beautiful 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home in excellent condition! This well-maintained property features a formal living room and dining room, plus a comfortable room off the modern kitchen with granite countertops and a sliding glass door leading to a 14' x 20' Trex deck. Enjoy outdoor living with a 16' x 32' in-ground pool with a new heater 2009, liner 2018, sand filter 2009, safety cover 2023, fenced-in backyard, and a peaceful wooded view.  Recent improvements include NEWLY PURCHASED APPLIANCES, an 18 kW Generac generator in 2023, Heat & Glo gas fireplace insert in 2022, Lennox furnace and central A/C with Nest thermostat in 2021, and updated 200-amp electric service with breakers also in 2021. Additional upgrades include Pella windows throughout 2009, living room bay window 2013, updated primary bath 2015 with bubble tub and TV, hardwood floors on the first floor 2003 & 2018, second-floor laundry closet, epoxy garage floor 2019, waterproofed basement with glass block windows, and vinyl siding 2009.  The property also offers an 8' x 14' storage shed matching the home 2016 and is ideally located on a cul-de-sac surrounded by lovely homes. This move-in-ready, low maintenance home combines thoughtful updates, comfortable living spaces, and a fantastic outdoor setting.
